data.body: S2 (f184) plan-review PASS after 6 passes (5->1->2->1->2->0 blocking); attestation signed. Final blocker was my own inconsistency: I disclosed the groq behavior change but was SILENT on google-vertex, which is equally in _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS and would have silently hit the conservative fallback. Fixing it surfaced that pydantic-ai 1.107.1s LIVE prefixes are google/google-cloud while google-gla/google-vertex/vertexai are DEPRECATED ALIASES — yet rebars own _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX EMITS google-gla, so omitting aliases would break rebars own model strings (S1s implementer hit the same asymmetry and added _DEPRECATED_PROVIDER_ALIASES — same trap twice in one epic). Enumerated all 9 resolver keys with verified supports_json_schema_output per key. google-vertex does NOT change behavior once enumerated; groq remains the ONLY disclosed change. Strengthened the AC from a single openai:gpt-4o case to a PARAMETERIZED test over every resolver key plus an assertion that nothing from _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS is dropped except groq — a single-case test would have passed while google-vertex silently regressed. S2 CLAIMED; starting the TDD loop with two corrections carried from S1: implementer brief requires the FULL gating suite (make test, not tests/unit), and I will RE-STRIP held-out tests before any re-dispatch (S1 round-2 hold-out breach).
